reading: Robert Pattinson, known for Twilight and The Batman, has been confirmed as the next actor to play James Bond.
Amazon MGM Studios shared the news on social media on Monday, alongside a picture of Pattinson as 007.
At 40, Pattinson becomes the seventh actor to take the role of the famous fictional spy.
The 26th Bond film is expected to be released in 2028.
Denis Villeneuve will direct the film, while Steven Knight will write it; its title and exact release date remain unknown.
The choice follows years of speculation about who would take over from Daniel Craig in this closely watched role.
Amazon MGM chose a household name, selecting a star widely seen as a reliable choice who could bring financial success.
Pattinson became famous as Cedric Diggory in Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire in 2005.
Together, his five Twilight films earned more than $3 billion worldwide at the box office, meaning income from cinema ticket sales.
He is also respected in the film industry for taking roles in smaller, independent and experimental films.
Reports suggested he had agreed to make three Bond films, but this deal has not been officially confirmed.
The film will also be the first Bond release since Amazon took creative control of the series.

vocabulary.definition: Officially stated that something is true or decided.

To begin doing a job or holding a position that another person had.

The money a film earns from cinema ticket sales.
The businesses and people involved in a particular type of work, such as making films.
Made outside the control of the main large film companies.
An agreement about work or business.
